name: swarm
description: Lead a team of cheap pi workers (OpenRouter models) on a big, splittable task: you plan, assign and judge, workers build in their own git worktrees, a shared SQLite database is the only channel, and only work that builds and passes tests gets merged.

interface.shortDescription: Lead a team of cheap AI agents
interface.longDescription:
Swarm turns your agent into the lead of a team of cheap pi coding agents running OpenRouter models. The lead splits a large task (a migration, many files, many tests) into subtasks that do not collide, starts each worker in its own git worktree, coordinates through a shared SQLite database, audits every command the workers ran, and merges only work that builds and passes the tests.

For developers with big, splittable work where one strong agent doing everything costs too much.

Limitations: it runs only when asked by name; it needs an OpenRouter API key with a credit limit and starts no workers under $5 left; workers run shell commands on the local machine without a sandbox, so use a disposable machine or VM; it needs a local executor (Codex CLI, the desktop app, Claude Code or pi) and does not run in web chat.
defaultPrompt: Use $swarm to split this migration across a team of pi workers.
Use $swarm to fix every failing test in this repo with a small team.
